# LVGL: Render

This sample runs the render demo that comes with
{doc}`LVGL <../../../third_party/lvgl>`: a scene per drawing primitive,
fills, borders, shadows, text, images, lines, arcs, triangles, layers and
blend modes, shown for a second each. It is meant for comparing what a
renderer draws with what another does.

The scenes are laid out for a display of 480x272 or more: a smaller one
shows the top left of each.
